verdict.rationale: The spec defines a skill as a SKILL.md file of YAML frontmatter plus Markdown, which can bundle scripts, references and templates in a folder. The CLI scaffolds SKILL.md templates, installs from a direct SKILL.md or archive URL, and writes skills into plain ./<agent>/skills/ directories that can be committed and symlinked across 77+ agents, with build-once reuse across any compatible agent. A keyless probe listed full skill descriptions readably before install, and community comment praised the agent-agnostic approach. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of manually copying a skill folder into a different harness and having it work unchanged.
